{{Quote|I've used every non-violent tactic in the book: threats, negotiation, sweet-talk... Now the gloves are coming off.|Emma Thex|<ref name="IT" />}}
'''Emma Thex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as an Imperial interrogation expert for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="IT" />

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|Ministry of War]] placed bounties on the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] after their enclave was discovered in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. After several Jedi were captured, Emma Thex began to interrogate them. Since her captives proved resilient toward her, she sent an Imperial hero to recover [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] interrogation droids from a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] storage facility.<ref name="IT" />
